purpose: Simple global Mapping output-template defaults, shared by logical_to_silver and dimensional_to_gold. Examples are synthetic.
rules: The existing Mapping response envelope retains target identity, modeled_attribute_name and object_dependency_order. These templates describe only the inner transformation documents.
Object fields are source_objects and steps. Both keys are present and either value may be JSON null. There is no grain field.

source_objects is a nullable list. Each entry is ordered tenant_code, system_code, connection_code, object_schema, object_name, alias. Use complete actual physical natural keys from eligible frozen evidence; no database IDs.
Aliases are unique SQL shorthand within the Object document. The same physical Object may appear under different aliases for an evidenced self-join.

steps is a nullable ordered list of strings. It carries all Object transformation instructions: which Objects/tables to join, join types and exact column predicates, filters, grouping, deduplication, and additional processing when needed. Array order is execution order.

Attribute fields are source_attributes and transformation. source_attributes is optional and may be omitted or JSON null. When supplied, it is a list of complete physical Attribute natural keys ordered tenant_code, system_code, connection_code, object_schema, object_name, attribute_name. It has no alias field.

transformation is required text containing the Attribute SQL expression or precise implementable generation rule, including needed cast/null/default/aggregation behavior. Use available Object aliases; put any self-join role distinction in transformation. There is no separate description field.

The document_schema values below record the confirmed shapes and nullability. The existing output-template registry records field presence with is_required and explains nullability in descriptions; it has no separate nullable column. Runtime templates remain advisory.

These approved definitions are the seeded global defaults for new Logical and Dimensional Mapping runs. Explicit custom template selections take precedence; existing saved mappings and frozen runs retain their original templates.

templates.output_template_description: Describe source Objects and ordered Object transformation steps; both values may be null.

fields.output_template_field_description: Nullable list of source Objects. Each entry has tenant_code, system_code, connection_code, object_schema, object_name, alias, in that order. The field is present and may be JSON null.

Nullable ordered list of Object transformation instructions: Objects/tables to join, join types and column predicates, filters and any additional processing. The field is present and may be JSON null.

templates.output_template_description: Describe optional source Attributes and the target Attribute transformation.

fields.output_template_field_description: Optional nullable list of source Attributes. Each entry has tenant_code, system_code, connection_code, object_schema, object_name, attribute_name, in that order. Omission or JSON null is permitted.
Required SQL expression using available Object aliases, or precise implementable generation rule. Include any necessary cast, null/default, aggregation or self-join source-role behavior.

nullable_example.transformation: Use the configured warehouse-generated identity policy.
